purpose: Stacked bounded 1С scoped machine-identity policy on the canonical seven-command connector protocol. Tightens bearer and persistent-record shapes before any credential persistence or runtime route exists.
requiredInvariants: The 1С connector authenticates as a machine, never by borrowing a farmer, accountant, administrator or tenant-wide human session.
Bearer material proves possession only; organization, 1С legal entity, connection, installation, protocol and command authorization remain server-owned state.
The bearer is exactly UUID + dot + 43 base64url characters from a 32-byte random secret; malformed or oversized input is rejected before hashing.
Persistent secret material is only a 16-byte random hex salt plus SHA-256 verifier; plaintext bearer secret is not part of the persistent record shape.
Verification is timing-safe and fails closed for malformed persistent state, expiry, revocation, scope mismatch, protocol drift, command denial or secret mismatch.
Revocation chronology cannot predate issuance and record version remains positive; future concurrent revoke/rotate authority belongs to the database transaction.
No credential persistence, Prisma migration, runtime route, provider traffic, Connection Center maturity change or production credential is introduced in this slice.
Generated cryptographic inventory remains reproducible and security gates are not weakened.
No new mandatory recurring cost is introduced.
